content:
Latest update, 6:30 PM Eastern Time: All user-facing issues are now marked as resolved. We will continue to monitor the remaining developer-facing issues. The original report follows.

Apple's system status page confirms that users and developers are currently experiencing issues with some services. Details are as follows.

Multiple Apple services are currently not functioning normally for some users

According to Apple's system status page, some users are experiencing issues with services such as Find My, Game Center, Photos, and iWork for iCloud.

Below are the company statements for each affected service. We will continue to update this list to reflect the latest affected services:

Find My – Issue started at 3:30 PM today (Eastern Time) – Ongoing Some users affected This service may be running slowly or unavailable.
Game Center – Issue started at 3:33 PM today (Eastern Time) – Ongoing All users affected Users are experiencing issues when using Game Center. We are actively investigating and will update the status once we have more information.
Cloud Calendar – Issue started at 3:33 PM today (Eastern Time) – Ongoing All users affected Some users may experience issues when using this service.
iWork for iCloud – Issue started at 3:33 PM today (Eastern Time) – Ongoing All users affected Some users may experience issues when using this service.
iCloud Contacts – Issue started at 3:33 PM today (Eastern Time) – Ongoing All users affected Some users may experience issues when using this service.
iCloud Mail – Issue started at 3:33 PM today (Eastern Time) – Ongoing All users affected Some users may experience issues when using this service.
iCloud Web Apps (iCloud.com) – Issue started at 3:33 PM today (Eastern Time) – Ongoing All users affected Some users may experience issues when using this service.
Photos – Issue started at 3:33 PM today (Eastern Time) – Ongoing All users affected Some users may experience issues when using this service.
iCloud Account & Sign In – Issue started at 3:33 PM today (Eastern Time) – Ongoing All users affected Some users may experience issues when using this service.

In addition, Apple's developer system status page shows that Xcode Cloud has been experiencing a service outage since 3:59 PM (Eastern Time). Apple stated that some users are "experiencing issues when using this service" and added that the company is "working to resolve the issue." In addition, Apple News API and News Publisher are also experiencing issues.

Although Apple's system status page clearly shows that this issue does not affect all users, the number of outage reports for iCloud and Find My services on Downdetector has continued to rise over the past hour.

We will continue to closely monitor the situation and will update this article when Apple announces more details or when the relevant systems are fully restored.
